text:
### Scope  
Applies to:
- All business processes
- All systems and technology
- All staff and contractors
- All products and services
- All geographic locations  
---
name: Chunk 4/32

raw_entities.name: Enterprise-Wide Policy Framework
raw_entities.description: A foundational policy establishing universal applicability across all organizational dimensions. This policy mandates comprehensive coverage of business processes, systems, technology infrastructure, personnel, products, services, and all geographic locations without exception.

raw_entities.name: Universal Application to Business Processes
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that the policy applies uniformly to all business processes conducted by the organization without exception or carve-out.

raw_entities.name: Universal Application to Systems and Technology
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that the policy applies uniformly to all systems and technology infrastructure used by the organization.

raw_entities.name: Universal Application to Staff and Contractors
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that the policy applies uniformly to all staff members and contractors engaged by the organization, regardless of employment status or tenure.

raw_entities.name: Universal Application to Products and Services
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that the policy applies uniformly to all products and services offered or delivered by the organization.

raw_entities.name: Universal Application to Geographic Locations
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that the policy applies uniformly across all geographic locations where the organization operates, with no territorial exemptions.
